summary: Iteration 3 — Promoter program addition. Backend pytest: 22/22 PASS covering per-program certificate issuance (RAWDJA-DJ-... and RAWDJA-PRMO-... serials with independent seq + hash chains), /api/stats {certificates_issued, dj, promoter}, ledger integrity with per-program head_hashes, teacher unlock returning program, /api/teacher/content?program=X and /api/teacher/pdf?program=X with cross-program 403 lock in BOTH directions (DJ-token vs promoter content => 403; promoter-token vs dj content => 403), 401 without token, verify returns program in cert. Frontend Playwright: /promoter loads 'THE PROMOTER' hero with 6 chapter cards; /promoter/chapter/promoter-origins renders (body 6.7KB); bonus /promoter/chapter/harm-reduction shows 'Goblin Mode' content; nav-switch-program toggles DJ<->Promoter; /promoter/certificate issues serial RAWDJA-PRMO-2026-00005-HE54MX and /certificate issues RAWDJA-DJ-2026-00006-ANL0LH; /promoter/teachers-guide rejects DJ serial with error 'That serial is a DJ Certification certificate. Use a Promoter Certification certificate to unlock this guide.' and stays locked; promoter serial unlocks the promoter guide (6 lessons + teacher PDF btn); reverse direction blocked with 'That serial is a Promoter Certification certificate. Use a DJ Certification certificate...' (gate stays); DJ serial unlocks /teachers-guide (6 lessons); per-program localStorage keys confirmed: rawdja_teacher_token_dj & rawdja_teacher_token_promoter; /promoter/downloads + /downloads show student & teacher buttons; shared /verify and /verify/:serial work for both DJ and Promoter serials. No issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _program_for() silently coerces invalid program param to 'dj' before comparing to token. If a promoter token requests program='bogus', it normalizes to 'dj' and returns 403 (good outcome), but it would be cleaner to 400 on bad program names.

server.py CertificateRequest defaults program='dj' and unknown values silently fall back to 'dj'. Consider Pydantic Literal['dj','promoter'] for explicit 422 on bad input (currently returns dj cert silently).
server.py: startup index migration tries db.certificates.drop_index('seq_1') on every boot — fine but noisy; once migrated everywhere, this can be removed.
server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to FastAPI lifespan handlers.
server.py CORS uses allow_origins default '*' from CORS_ORIGINS env; pin to known origins in prod (already safe because allow_credentials=False).
teacher_content.py: large constants live alongside DJ + Promoter content; if a 3rd program is added, consider splitting per-program modules under a content/ package.

Frontend per-program localStorage keys ('rawdja_teacher_token_dj' / '_promoter') are correct, but consider also auto-clearing on 401 from /api/teacher/* so the gate reappears without a manual lock click.
